gaps.range: Solutions outside linked public video/written ranges
gaps.detail: Own worked exposition included only where verified. Commercial-book solutions have not been copied. Missing solutions remain explicitly absent.

method: Every decision was individually authored after reading the specific official problem and analysing its mathematical structure. Difficulty is a subjective AI estimate, not an official UKMT score; it is not inferred from question position. Some solutions were worked through directly; official linked videos/PDFs are identified as available resources, not claimed fully transcribed or individually watched.
yearConvention: The year field follows official archive filenames. From BMO1-2002 onward, BMO1 was sat in the preceding calendar year and its season is recorded. BMO2 uses the January/February calendar year. BMO1-2026 was sat 19 November 2025 and is released. Historical BMO 1988 was sat 20 November 1987 and BMO 1989 was sat 13 December 1988. Per-record sittingDate fields retain the actual dated headers; undated 1973/1974 papers have no invented date.
copyright: Statements are compact original paraphrases preserving mathematical conditions; linked official solutions remain on UKMT servers. Own solutions are original exposition.
